meta.title: ToC2ME induced seismicity, Alberta — machine-learning catalogue with confirmability score
meta.citation: Meng, L., Huang, H., Ma, J.-Z. & Ma, Y. (2026), data and code for the preprint "Can human seismologists verify machine-learning detected earthquakes?" (under review).
meta.notes: Score = released confirmability score, a ranking, not a calibrated probability. Tiers T/M/B = thirds by score within this catalogue, not matched in magnitude or depth.
